title: Validation against real HamLib files at 28, 32, 40 qubits (R=0.70 STO-6G, ham_JW)
source: HamLib (Sawaya et al.), NERSC portal; files provided by user
conclusion: Generated Hamiltonians are physically identical to HamLib at 28/32/40q: exact term-count match, identical Pauli structure, identical coefficient magnitudes (one-norms to ~15 sig figs). Only difference = orbital-phase sign convention on off-diagonal terms (all differences are exact sign-flips with preserved magnitudes), a gauge choice that leaves the spectrum exactly invariant. Earlier H2-H6: full spectra reproduced to 0.00000 mHa.
